name: 落锚湾
summary: 从外海登陆后的第一张关键地图，优先顺路清理任务点，能把开荒节奏重新拉直。
route: 沿海岸线推进，先清入口附近的支线角落，再贴着主路找出口，避免在外圈来回折返。

en.name: Kedge Bay
en.summary: The first key landing map after reaching the outer coast. Clear nearby objectives while moving forward to keep campaign tempo clean.
en.route: Follow the coastline, sweep the small side pockets near the entrance, then stay on the main path toward the exit to avoid outer-loop backtracking.

name: 瓦卡帕努岛
summary: 这张图的价值在于任务推进和奖励回报，边找任务物边收基础资源最划算。
route: 先确认岛心地标，再按顺时针清外围营地；任务物通常和小型战斗房绑定。

en.name: Whakapanu Island
en.summary: This map is mainly valuable for quest progress and reward pickup. Collect basic resources while hunting the quest item.
en.route: Identify the central island landmark first, then clear outer camps clockwise. Quest items are usually tied to compact combat rooms.

name: 亲眷岛
summary: 兼顾战斗密度和奖励效率，适合顺着主线时补几件关键掉落。
route: 从主路推进到岛内高地，遇到分叉先看小地图边界；奖励点多在死路尽头。

zh.name: 亲眷岛

en.name: Isle of Kin
en.summary: A good balance of combat density and reward efficiency, useful for picking up key drops while staying on the main route.
en.route: Push from the main road into the island highland. When paths split, read the minimap border first; reward nodes often sit at dead ends.

name: 废弃监牢
summary: 路线稍绕，但奖励质量高，尤其适合补通货和确认支线奖励是否漏拿。
route: 先清牢区主走廊，再折回两侧牢房；看到封闭门厅时优先检查奖励和永久增益。

en.name: Solitary Confinement
en.summary: The path bends around more than the coast maps, but the reward quality is higher for currency and permanent side rewards.
en.route: Clear the main prison corridor first, then double back through side cells. Closed halls are priority checks for rewards and permanent bonuses.
